projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.golden_c: Golden chains rise from a binding rune circle and hold the target for 3 s (bosses 1 s), 8 damage. If you just miss, it takes the creature nearest your aim. +3 Dominion.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.glyph_st: A rune circle opens in the sky and rains golden hieroglyph blades for 3 s onto a 7-block circle where you look: 5 damage per hit (7 hits) to every threat inside, and they're slowed. +8 Dominion.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.ankh_ste: Blink through a golden ankh portal 12 blocks along your look (6 without the helmet). Looking a little down still steps you along the ground. 2 s cooldown.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.gate_dro: An ankh gate opens under the target and its twin 15 blocks above: it's hurled down and takes the fall, and you blink beside where it lands. Bosses are too heavy. +5 Dominion.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.amulet_o: Tap: grip the Amulet of Anubis and steady your mind, Dominion -10 (helmet on or off, 2 min cooldown). Hold for 1 s instead to enter the Tower of Fate and speak with Nabu.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.mindscap: Hold Shift+V for 1 s: your mind goes into the Tower of Fate and Nabu's helmet speaks. Ask how strong his hold is, bargain for a Blessing, a Silence or a Debt, or learn his lore. The world keeps going while you talk.
Hold Shift+V for 1 s (a tap is still the Amulet) and your mind goes into the Tower of Fate, where you speak with Nabu through dialogue choices. Your body stays where it was and the world doesn't pause. Ask how strong his hold is (free). Blessing of Order: with the helmet on, spells deal 30% more for 30 s, for +15 Dominion (every 3 min). Silence: for 60 s no Override, no Pull, no lagging keys and no whispers, but every spell's Dominion counts 1.5 times. He refuses it from 75 Dominion up (every 5 min). Debt: Dominion -25 now, but 10 minutes later he collects 35 (one debt at a time, not below 10 Dominion). You can settle a debt early for 30. He also tells you about the Lords of Order, the Helmet of Fate and Kent Nelson.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.landing.bo: Come down fast out of flight and you make a superhero landing: a golden ankh flares on the ground under you and a ring of hieroglyphs races out. No fall damage.
projecthero.guide.shazam.landing.body: Come down fast out of flight and you slam into the ground: glowing lightning cracks race out from your fist, and on a hard landing a bolt answers from the sky. No fall damage.
projecthero.guide.shazam.lightning.body: Your moves cost lightning. Every transform bolt refills it, it fills during thunderstorms, and other lightning striking near you tops it up. At 60% or more you're charged: lightning crackles round your hands and your eyes glow.
A red blur 12 blocks along your look, leaving streaks, after-images and a crackle of lightning behind you. Looking a little down still dashes you along the ground. Free.

screen.projecthero.doctor_fate.mind.repl: You come to the Tower of your own will. Good. Speak, vessel, and choose your words with care.
You knock at my door again. I have been guiding your hand. You have noticed. Speak.
Your thoughts grow quiet here, and mine grow loud. Ask what you came to ask.
You stand in my Tower, but it is no longer yours to leave so easily. Speak while you still can.
My hold on you is %s of a hundred. A whisper. Order is patient.
%s of a hundred. When I see a better spell, I cast it, and the innocent are safe from your hand.
%s of a hundred. Your aim bends toward Chaos, and your voice carries my name.
%s of a hundred. Your body answers me before it answers you. At a hundred, it is mine.
Then take it. Your spells burn with Order for %2$s seconds. And I take %1$s more of you.
My strength flows through the helmet. Wear it, and ask again.
Very well. I will be silent for %s seconds. But I will count every spell you cast, and I will remember.
Silence? No. You are too far into my keeping to be left alone now.
Done. I release %1$s of my hold. In %3$s minutes I take back %2$s. Order always collects.
You already owe me %s, due in %s seconds. One debt at a time, vessel.
You offer me a future I do not yet need. Come back when my hold is worth trading.
Honest. I take %s now, and the debt is gone.
You owe me nothing. Yet.
The Lords of Order keep the balance of all things against the Lords of Chaos. I am Nabu, the last of my kind to walk among mortals.
The Helmet of Fate is my vessel and my prison. Whoever wears it wields my power, and lends me their body to do it.
Kent Nelson wore it longest. He learned to bargain with me, and to refuse me. Few others have.
I have answered that already. Ask again in %s seconds.
Go, then. I will be here. I am always here.
The time has come. I take back the %s you owe me.
